Legacy VarMan VIs

Owning Palette: Variable Manager

VIs to maintain compatibility for legacy applications. These VIs can still be used but have modern successors.

 

Palette Object Description
VM - 1D Array of CDB.vi Manages variables of the 1D Array of CDB data type.
VM - 1D Array of DBL.vi Manages variables of the 1D Array of DBL data type.
VM - 1D Array of Strings.vi Manages variables of the 1D Array of Strings data type.
VM - 2D Array of CDB.vi Manages variables of the 2D Array of CDB data type.
VM - 2D Array of DBL.vi Manages variables of the 2D Array of DBL data type.
VM - 2D Array of Strings.vi Manages variables of the 2D Array of Strings data type.
VM - Arbitrary Data.vi Manages variables that may have an arbitrary data type; both predefined and user-defined data types are supported. Variable values are represented in the Flattened-To-String format, except for String variables, which use the native LabVIEW string representation. You can use this VI as a basis to build VIs that manage variables of custom data types.
VM - CDB Scalar.vi Manages variables of the CDB Number data type.
VM - DBL Scalar.vi Manages variables of the DBL Number data type.
VM - Strings.vi Manages variables of the String data type.
